channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Darren Collison | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Darren Collison from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Darren Collison
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Russell Westbrook on being teammates with Darren Collison again:

“It's great to see him back in the NBA. A good friend of mine.... It's good to have him back in the locker room.”

Russell Westbrook on Darren Collison, Dec 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Darren Collison
item.description:
Ben Bolch:Doc Rivers on Darren Collison:

“I wanted to keep him. I thought he would have been perfect for here forever. But I know math a little bit.”

Doc Rivers on Darren Collison, Nov 2, 2014. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Darren Collison, DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
“Before every game, to hear CP, Jamal, (DeAndre Jordan), Matt (Barnes), (Darren Collison), on down the line to our whole coaching staff say, 'Go attack, go score, go do what you do' is a confidence builder. That gets me into the game.”

Blake Griffin on Darren Collison, DeAndre Jordan, Apr 22, 2014. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Darren Collison, Jared Dudley, JJ Redick, DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Doc Rivers:

“Well, Chris is going to be a Hall of Famer, and so should Blake (Griffin) and DJ (DeAndre Jordan), hopefully, but we were getting (surefire future Hall of Famers). Paul was and Ray and Kevin are, so in that terms, that day is bigger just because of those three guys. You just don't bring those three guys together very often. This was neater in one way in that it was more about the key guys, signing Chris back, bringing Matt back, and getting Darren Collison and JJ Redick and Jared Dudley, it's more that we're building this team, and that was a great message … I couldn't have asked for a better day.”

Doc Rivers on Darren Collison, Jared Dudley, JJ Redick, DeAndre Jordan, Jul 12, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Darren Collison
item.description:
Donnie Nelson:

“We’ve been spoiled with Jason Kidd and Steve Nash before, and I think the point guard position is just a really important one. I’d say that that’s up there. That’s no disrespect to anyone. Darren Collison did a terrific job with a tough situation, and we would certainly be open to the conversation of him coming back.”

Donnie Nelson on Darren Collison, Apr 20, 2013. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Darren Collison, Derek Fisher
item.description:
Bryan Gutierrez:Carlisle on Fisher:

“He’s probably going to be our starting point guard. We’ve got a great situation with him and Collison.”

Rick Carlisle on Darren Collison, Derek Fisher, Nov 30, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: OJ Mayo on Darren Collison
item.description:
“Competing against Darren, I understand he’s a great player and a heck of a competitor. When we play in the summertime at UCLA, we’re actually on the same team a lot of time just because we’re familiar with each other and feel like that can give us an edge in pickup games.”

OJ Mayo on Darren Collison, Sep 21, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Darren Collison, Chris Kaman, Dahntay Jones
item.description:
Mavericks coach Rick Carlisle said.

“Collison is well thought of as a player and a person, and Kaman has been one of the better low-post players in the league for the last eight years. We feel Dahntay Jones is a premier defender that brings toughness and he shot the 3 well the last two years.”

Rick Carlisle on Darren Collison, Chris Kaman, Dahntay Jones, Jul 13, 2012. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Darren Collison, George Hill
item.description:
Frank Vogel on the point guard situation between Darren Collison and George Hill (if Hill re-signs):

“I would hope that (Hill) stays at the level that he played at during the end of this year and that he would be the starting point guard. But I could definitely see a situation where Darren, one of the most driven players I've ever been around, comes back and outplays George. He's that driven and that's a real possibility. I'm hoping that we have them both back; that they both strive to get better in the offseason and I have a very difficult decision to make next year. That's what I hope.”

Frank Vogel on Darren Collison, George Hill, May 30, 2012. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Larry Bird on Darren Collison
item.description:
The Pacers envision Collison, who turns 23 on Aug. 23, dishing to Danny Granger, Brandon Rush, Tyler Hansbrough and Roy Hibbert for years.

“Just like I told Darren awhile ago, I think this is the piece we needed,”

Larry Bird on Darren Collison, Aug 12, 2010. Source: Indianapolis Star.
